summary.zh: 新增 agenthelm relocate：把一个 Skill 复制或迁移到另一个客户端/作用域，默认预览，带计划指纹确认；不覆盖已有目录，读回校验，失败回滚，源只归档不删除；放宽作用域需 --allow-widen。
summary.en: Add agenthelm relocate: copy or move one Skill to another client/scope. Preview by default, confirmed with a plan digest; never overwrites an existing directory, reads back and verifies, rolls back on failure and only archives (never deletes) the source; widening the scope needs --allow-widen.
